grh_f166bd4a60010c2fb403.title: Yukon Joes Gold Mine
paragraphs: Nurse Parker and Dr. Carrou buy shares in Yukon Joe Moran's supposedly rich Moosehead Rock gold mine, only for Kildare and Gillespie to confirm that the land is real but the mine is worthless. When Joe refuses to return their money, Kildare persuades a newspaper editor to print a single fake special edition announcing a huge strike at Moosehead Rock; Joe sees the headline, panics and buys Parker's share back at full price. Carrou, however, secretly sees the same paper first and outsmarts himself by buying even more of the worthless property, leaving Parker rescued and Carrou holding the swindle.

This [[show|dr-kildare|Dr. Kildare]] broadcast aired on April 13, 1951. The cast includes Lionel Barrymore, Lew Ayres, [[person|virginia-gregg|Virginia Gregg]], Ted Osborne, and [[person|georgia-ellis|Georgia Ellis]]. Other credited names include Joe Bigelow as director, Raymond Katz as producer, Joel Murcott as writer, and Dick Joy as announcer.
